title: IIT Delhi Alumnus’ Startup Sues Apple For ₹1,500 Cr Over NameDrop Patent Infringement
summary: What happens when two iPhones are brought close together? Users get to exchange contact details without typing or scanning a…
llm_summary: A startup founded by an IIT Delhi alumnus has filed a lawsuit against Apple, claiming the tech giant’s “NameDrop” feature—introduced in iOS 17 for swapping contact info by simply bringing two iPhones close together—violates the company’s patent on the same proximity‑based data‑exchange technology.
